name: Grid Invoke
description:
Submit an operation by reference on this venue, or on the explicit venue target, and return its Job snapshot without waiting for completion. Use grid_run to wait for the result. Discover operation references through the catalog; they may be venue paths, user pins, asset hashes, or DID URLs. A DID URL identifies where to fetch the definition, not where to execute it. Pass venue explicitly for remote execution. Poll with grid_job_status or wait with grid_job_result.

Requires invoke on the requested operation reference or a containing operation tree. This is permission to look up and start that operation, not permission to access its underlying resources. The operation enforces those permissions under the caller authority at the execution venue. A direct tool binding to an operation does not itself require invoke; this tool does because it accepts an arbitrary operation reference.

operation.description: Operation definition reference: v/ops/<group>/<op>, o/<pin>, a/<hash>, or a DID URL. A remote definition is fetched and executed locally unless venue explicitly selects another execution venue.

input.description: Arguments matching the operation's input schema (any JSON value — object, array, string, number, boolean, or null). Read the schema first via covia_read v/ops/<group>/<op>.

venue.description: Optional remote venue URL or DID — for one-off federation without changing the operation reference.

authenticateAs.description: Explicit remote authentication mode. caller requires a target-audienced empty-att identity credential; venue is only for the venue itself. UCAN grant presence never selects a mode.

output.description: Job status information returned by the venue

status.description: Current job status (e.g. PENDING, STARTED, COMPLETE, FAILED, CANCELLED)

created.description: Timestamp when the job was created (milliseconds since epoch)

updated.description: Timestamp when the job status was last updated (milliseconds since epoch)

error.description: Error message if the job failed
